Class CourseExceptionHandler

java.lang.Object
edu.ai.lms.core.course.adapter.out.exception.CourseExceptionHandler
@RestControllerAdvice(basePackages="edu.ai.lms.core.course.adapter.in") public class CourseExceptionHandler extends Object
Global exception handler for course-related exceptions. Handles validation errors and custom course exceptions.
